label: About
title: About Bone Light, Coral Heat
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1 recent saved-signal files and 3 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around @gucci4mycat: 11 days. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Bone Light, Coral Heat: Landscape coral-pink; unequal skull and bob-face islands across broad coral. Navy swept hair, ivory skull, orange sockets, dark nose wedge, thin teeth; small white face, pointed black fringe, outlined eyes. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Tall ragged cream wipe with turquoise-yellow edge traces and Tall cream pigment wipe with ragged turquoise-yellow edges.

typography.rationale: Fraunces and Newsreader fit image-led art objects while Space Grotesk keeps process labels crisp.
